rationale: Name the unreferenced --validate run of the import-design CLI as a skip rather than letting it read as a pass. Before this change, --validate without --reference rendered the generated JS, printed only the render path, and exited 0, so every caller that checked the exit code read a run that reached no verdict at all as a successful validation. The CLI now carries a third validation outcome alongside pass and needs-review: it prints Validation: SKIPPED (no reference image) with a note explaining that a render is not a pass, and a new opt-in --fail-on-unvalidated flag makes that state exit 6 for a lane that wants it to be fatal. This is exit-code and reporting honesty in the CLI plus its help text and the import-design skill document; no generator, importer, DesignIR, packaging, or shipped output behaviour changes, no accepted expansion boundary moves, and no Vellum source authority is touched, so the disposition is watch-only.
